summary: Valaris Ltd filed an 8-K updating its pending acquisition by Transocean Ltd under a Business Combination Agreement dated February 9, 2026. Transocean will acquire all outstanding Valaris common shares for 15.235 Transocean shares per Valaris share, a stock-for-stock offshore drilling merger. On October 13, 2026, Brazil's CADE cleared the deal without restrictions; publication in Brazil's Official Journal on October 15-16, 2026 starts a 15-day waiting period before the decision becomes final. All regulatory approval conditions would then be satisfied, with closing anticipated in Q4 2026. Watch publication timing, the 15-day clock, and remaining closing conditions.
